Body.raw:
this is a half-bakery of not-fully-formed ideas for improvements -- or debuffs

Scope: todo.py (skills/projectmanagement/todos/) and the projectmanagement skill docs. Each note
below is one idea, unranked and unvetted. Promoting one means minting its own todo for it.

## Note 1: one cross-cutting vertical-slice todo shared by several horizontal todos (many-to-many)

Origin, 2026-09-25, easternlabs/opportunity: three stacked tickets, bottom to top --
todo:dea728c1 (jira:BH-791, DB currency columns), todo:e21ac2ab (jira:BH-1004, carry currency
across the wire), todo:64871441 (jira:BH-795, frontend Money type). One vertical slice cuts
across all three: express.loan_application.requested_amount traced DB -> wire -> render and back.
It is held as per-ticket work items that point at each other (todo:dea728c1/objid:001e,
todo:e21ac2ab/objid:0003 and objid:0004), with the seven-layer test outline restated in pieces.

The idea: a fourth todo holds the slice, is registered as a subtodo of all three horizontal
todos, and appears as the same spawn-subtodo work item in each of their lists.

Pros:
- One home for the plan and the test outline. Keeping one slice's story consistent across the
  three todos plus a Jira ticket took eight separate edits.
- One done-ness: the slice is done when every layer passes, not "DB part done, wire part pending".
- The slice's branch is one reviewable diff across DB, wire and UI.
- All three parents' cursors can wait-for the same child.

Cons:
- The merge target is ambiguous under stacked branches. Merging into the bottom of the stack puts
  wire and TypeScript code in the DB ticket's PR; merging into the top ships the DB ticket's PR
  without the slice's migration. Either way one-ticket-per-PR breaks (opportunity's PR-title lint
  does allow up to four ticket keys, so a joint PR is legal there).
- The relation model is one parent per child today (add-subtodo / merge-subtodo, Parent[] on the
  child, Subtodos[] on the parent). Unverified whether several parents can hold the same child, or
  what merge-subtodo records in each.
- Three parents each recording one merge is three State flips that can disagree.

Cleanest variant: split plan from code. The cross-cutting todo holds the plan and the
verification, with no branch of its own, and relates to the three; each horizontal todo keeps its
own code work item. Needs a relationship kind like SLICE-OF / SHARED-CHILD in the vocabulary
todo:3d696168 (fold relation commands into one `todo relate`) is choosing.

Summary.raw: todo tool + skill half-bakery: speculative, not-fully-formed improvement ideas (or debuffs)
